_readme: One entry per project card. Display order = array order. To hide a project, add "hidden": true. 'links' keys (repo/demo/devpost/writeup) are all optional — omit what doesn't exist and nothing renders. 'timeframe' is an optional small date label. 'visuals' is a list of images/GIFs; if empty (or a file is missing) the card shows a styled 'awaiting capture' frame instead of breaking. Image files go in public/images/projects/. Wrap key numbers in **double asterisks**. Field docs: src/lib/content.ts.

entries.title: Spectra
entries.tagline: ACM Research — stress-testing vision-language models against visual prompt injection.
entries.description: Visual prompt injection hides malicious instructions inside images — invisible to people, obeyed by vision-language models, and **OWASP's top LLM security risk**. As one of four researchers, I helped stress-test **13 open VLMs** against a full spectrum of attacks across **3,200+ medical scans**, cutting attack success from **90.9% to 26%** on Gemma-3 and Qwen-2.5. The headline result: **simple, fast preprocessing defenses nearly eliminated some attacks at production-ready speeds**, while several intuitive defenses backfired and left models more vulnerable.

entries.title: SpinStack
entries.tagline: ACM Projects — a mobile social-music app for the 10-to-30-second moments that hit hardest in a song.
entries.description: Instead of whole tracks, SpinStack is built around **song moments** — short snippets personalized with captions and cover art, collected into **vinyl-style stacks**. Friends discover music through each other: a Pinterest-style vertical feed, stacks followed like shared musical journals, and a **daily group prompt** where friends post and rate each other's picks. I built the backend — REST APIs on Node.js, Express, and TypeScript over Supabase/PostgreSQL and S3 — reaching **sub-200ms** search and playback flows and presenting to a panel of five industry judges.

entries.title: MEMEoTron
entries.tagline: HackUTD 2025 — a multimodal agentic workflow that turns viral memes into culturally aware insights for market researchers.
entries.description: Extracts linguistic and spatial metadata from viral images — **1,000+ processed at 95% OCR accuracy** — through a Python + Google Cloud Vision pipeline, then pipes the results through a Flask API to web-scraping agents backed by Nvidia's Nemotron, so the system can explain the joke in **under 300ms**.

entries.title: E-Wise
entries.tagline: NTHS Hack 2025 — diagnose a broken device from a single photo.
entries.description: Upload one photo of a broken device and E-Wise identifies the component, suggests repairs, and points to nearby recycling locations — a responsive HTML/CSS/JavaScript front end feeding a Python pipeline of **10 integrated APIs**. Refined through live user testing (**~30% faster navigation**) and placed **top 30 of 100+ teams**.
